prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1131
Claimant:
Matthew Cervantes
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
13 Jul 2024
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured's vehicle was changing lanes. The claimant reports a
knee injury and is not represented by an attorney.
18 Jul 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the coverage was in force at the time of the incident.
Nothing so far suggests the damage predates the policy start.
3 Aug 2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Requested photos from
the scene and the repair facility.
2 Sep 2024
Photos received. They confirm several points of the described impact, including contact along the passenger side
panel. No independent witnesses have come forward to date.
12 Sep 2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of the lane change and the conatct matches the initial report, and the
claimant described the knee injury without any changes to the earlier statement.
22 Sep 2024
Reviewed the damage estimate. The damage is mostly consistent with the described impact. A few old scratches
near the rear quarter panel may predate this crash, so the appraiser has been asked to note them separately.
14 Oct 2024
Obtained the medical summary. The reported knee injury is plausible for a collision of this type. No prior injury to the
same body area is on record.
12 Nov 2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of knee injury. Requested the treating provider's notes
to understand the timeline of care.
17 Nov 2024
Follow-up call with the claimant. The claimant repeated the same account of events as in every prior conversation,
with no new details added or removed.
23 Nov 2024
Reviewed the provider notes and the photos together. The overlal picture is consistent with the reported crash. The
extended treatment period remains the main open question and is being monitored.
25 Dec 2024
File updated with current findings. Injury evaluation and the separate note on the older scratches remain pending
before the claim is finalized.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
